title: Public STAGE demo mode (owner decision 2026-11-08): once STAGE is up it becomes a public demo that anyone can reach, with published demo passwords, data reset every 60 minutes and no search engine indexing. A `MPMV_DEMO_MODE` setting, off by default; a Django system check refuses to start when it is on in the LIVE settings. Demo accounts: a customer, a vendor owner and a staff member with limited rights; never a superuser, and no account can manage users, permissions, groups or API keys; the technical Django admin stays restricted (OPS.5). Demo passwords come from server environment configuration (never the repo) and are shown in a demo panel on the STAGE login page. Demo accounts are exempt from MFA and from account lockout (otherwise anyone could lock them for everyone); a per-IP rate limit applies instead. No outbound email: messages land in an in-app demo mailbox; payments use the provider's test mode only. Hourly reset: the database is restored from a snapshot of the synthetic seed (ARC.10) and uploaded media are wiped; a site-wide banner shows "Demo: data resets at HH:MM, do not enter real data"; uploads accept images only, with a size cap. Not indexable: an `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` header on every response, a robots meta tag in the base layout and a `robots.txt` that disallows crawling. ARC.21 abuse tests run with demo mode off, in a maintenance window
done_when: On STAGE with demo mode on, each demo login works from the login-page panel; a demo account cannot reach user, permission or key management; no email leaves the server; a reset restores the seed and wipes uploads within the hour, and the banner shows the next reset time; every response carries the noindex header; LIVE settings with demo mode on fail the system check
